original_question: List both current members of the fictional Birch Board with seat and party on 2026-10-30, and establish whether the two Smith records represent distinct people.
scope_in: Members holding occupied board seats on 2026-10-30; current seat and party.

goals.question: List both current members of the fictional Birch Board with seat and party on 2026-10-30, and establish whether the two Smith records represent distinct people.

criteria.measurement_method: Reconcile dated source evidence with eligible member records.

criteria.description: Establish whether John K Smith and John Kenneth Smith are distinct individuals using the associated source reconciliation.

qualification_requirements.scope: Current board membership with seat and party on 2026-10-30.

assessments.rationale: Roster record was extracted; source context retained for coverage assessment.

source_stated_metadata.title: Birch Board same-day record reconciliation
declarations: Effective 2026-10-30: John K Smith (person ID B101, East) and John Kenneth Smith (person ID B202, West) are two distinct individuals, not alternative names for one person.

Two equally authoritative records effective 2026-10-30 conflict on John Kenneth Smith B202: the roster states Blue party, while the signed affiliation register states Red party. Neither document supersedes the other and no resolution is supplied.
